# ModGuard AI

> AI safety studio. The only live product is ScamCheck, a free AI scam checker.

ModGuard AI (https://modguardai.org) is an AI safety studio. ScamCheck (https://scamcheck.modguardai.org) is the first shipped tool.

## ScamCheck

ScamCheck is a free AI scam checker. You can submit:

- a message, including a text or email
- a link
- a screenshot of a text or email

A check returns an AI verdict. Links are also checked against known-phishing blocklists from OpenPhish and Phishing Army. ScamCheck includes a newsletter.

Other ModGuard work is in research. This site does not describe unreleased capabilities or dates.

## Pages

- [Home](https://modguardai.org/): One headline, then the tools
- [ScamCheck](https://modguardai.org/scamcheck): Free message checker, embedded from https://scamcheck.modguardai.org
- [Impersonation Check](https://modguardai.org/impersonation-check): Free handle check, then the $199 manual sweep
- [Insights](https://modguardai.org/insights): Sourced notes on fraud, impersonation, passkeys, breaches, and labeling rules
- [Sponsors](https://modguardai.org/sponsor): Starter, Growth, and Elite
- [About](https://modguardai.org/about): What the studio is
- [Playbook](https://scamcheck.modguardai.org/playbook): Paid PDF, separate from the free checker

## Terms this site uses

- AI scam checker
- check if a message is a scam
- phishing link checker
